QuestInfo.name: [Shaolin Temple] Making a Mask
QuestInfo.0: Make a human mask for #b#p9310578##k. Talk to #p9310034#, the dermatologist at Mount Song Hamlet.
QuestInfo.1: #p9310034# says that the soft leather used to make masks is stored at the Sutra Depository warehouse, but Silver Demons stole it all. Defeat some and gather up the leather.
QuestInfo.2: You've made a human mask. Return to the #m701220350#.\r\n

default.0: (Hunt #o9600022# monsters and #o9600024# monsters at the Sutra Depository to get the leather.)
